events.title: Mercurius becomes Pope John II, the first pope to change his name
events.description: The Roman priest Mercurius, reluctant to reign under the name of a pagan god, took the name John II on his consecration. Adopting a papal name later became the settled custom of the Church.
events.html: The Roman priest Mercurius, reluctant to reign under the name of a pagan god, took the name John II on his consecration. Adopting a papal name later became the settled custom of the Church.

events.title: Granada surrenders to Ferdinand and Isabella
events.description: Emir Muhammad XII handed the keys of Granada to the Catholic Monarchs, ending the last Muslim state in Iberia after nearly eight centuries. Months later the same monarchs sponsored Columbus's first voyage.
events.html: Emir Muhammad XII handed the keys of Granada to the Catholic Monarchs, ending the last Muslim state in Iberia after nearly eight centuries. Months later the same monarchs sponsored Columbus's first voyage.

events.title: Maria Theresa abolishes judicial torture in Austria
events.description: Persuaded by reformers such as Joseph von Sonnenfels, Empress Maria Theresa ended the use of torture in criminal proceedings in her Austrian and Bohemian lands. It was a landmark of Enlightenment legal reform.
events.html: Persuaded by reformers such as Joseph von Sonnenfels, Empress Maria Theresa ended the use of torture in criminal proceedings in her Austrian and Bohemian lands. It was a landmark of Enlightenment legal reform.

events.title: Washington repulses Cornwallis at Assunpink Creek
events.description: At the Second Battle of Trenton, Washington's army held the bridge over Assunpink Creek against repeated British attacks. That night the Americans slipped away to strike Princeton the next morning.
events.html: At the Second Battle of Trenton, Washington's army held the bridge over Assunpink Creek against repeated British attacks. That night the Americans slipped away to strike Princeton the next morning.

events.title: Georgia ratifies the US Constitution
events.description: Georgia's convention voted unanimously to ratify the new federal Constitution, making it the fourth state to do so. A frontier state facing conflict with the Creek, Georgia valued the protection of a stronger union.
events.html: Georgia's convention voted unanimously to ratify the new federal Constitution, making it the fourth state to do so. A frontier state facing conflict with the Creek, Georgia valued the protection of a stronger union.

events.title: Institution of Civil Engineers founded in London
events.description: Three young engineers met at a London coffee house to found the Institution of Civil Engineers. Under Thomas Telford, its president from 1820, it became the model for professional engineering bodies worldwide.
events.html: Three young engineers met at a London coffee house to found the Institution of Civil Engineers. Under Thomas Telford, its president from 1820, it became the model for professional engineering bodies worldwide.

events.title: Union holds the field at the Battle of Stones River
events.description: A failed Confederate assault on the final day of fighting near Murfreesboro, Tennessee, led Braxton Bragg to withdraw. The costly Union success lifted Northern morale after the defeat at Fredericksburg.
events.html: A failed Confederate assault on the final day of fighting near Murfreesboro, Tennessee, led Braxton Bragg to withdraw. The costly Union success lifted Northern morale after the defeat at Fredericksburg.

events.title: John Hay promotes the Open Door Policy towards China
events.description: US Secretary of State John Hay pressed the great powers to grant equal trading rights in China and respect its territorial integrity. The Open Door became a cornerstone of American policy in East Asia.
events.html: US Secretary of State John Hay pressed the great powers to grant equal trading rights in China and respect its territorial integrity. The Open Door became a cornerstone of American policy in East Asia.

events.title: Palmer Raids sweep up thousands of suspected radicals
events.description: Federal agents directed by Attorney General A. Mitchell Palmer arrested thousands of suspected communists and anarchists in cities across the United States. The raids marked the height of the first Red Scare.
events.html: Federal agents directed by Attorney General A. Mitchell Palmer arrested thousands of suspected communists and anarchists in cities across the United States. The raids marked the height of the first Red Scare.

events.title: Japanese forces occupy Manila
events.description: Japanese troops entered Manila, declared an open city after American and Filipino forces withdrew to Bataan. The Philippine capital remained under Japanese occupation until its devastating liberation in 1945.
events.html: Japanese troops entered Manila, declared an open city after American and Filipino forces withdrew to Bataan. The Philippine capital remained under Japanese occupation until its devastating liberation in 1945.

events.title: India institutes the Bharat Ratna, its highest civilian award
events.description: President Rajendra Prasad established the Bharat Ratna to honour exceptional national service. The first recipients were C. Rajagopalachari, Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan and the physicist C. V. Raman.
events.html: President Rajendra Prasad established the Bharat Ratna to honour exceptional national service. The first recipients were C. Rajagopalachari, Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan and the physicist C. V. Raman.

events.title: Soviet Union launches Luna 1 towards the Moon
events.description: Luna 1 lifted off from Baikonur and became the first spacecraft to reach escape velocity. It missed the Moon but passed close by and entered orbit around the Sun, the first human-made object to do so.
events.html: Luna 1 lifted off from Baikonur and became the first spacecraft to reach escape velocity. It missed the Moon but passed close by and entered orbit around the Sun, the first human-made object to do so.

events.title: Viet Cong defeat a larger South Vietnamese force at Ap Bac
events.description: Communist guerrillas in the Mekong Delta beat off a South Vietnamese attack backed by American helicopters and advisers. The battle exposed weaknesses in the Saigon army and US optimism about the war.
events.html: Communist guerrillas in the Mekong Delta beat off a South Vietnamese attack backed by American helicopters and advisers. The battle exposed weaknesses in the Saigon army and US optimism about the war.

events.title: NASA's Stardust probe flies through the tail of comet Wild 2
events.description: Stardust passed within about 240 km of comet Wild 2's nucleus, collecting dust in blocks of aerogel. The samples, returned to Earth in 2006, were the first material ever brought back from a comet.
events.html: Stardust passed within about 240 km of comet Wild 2's nucleus, collecting dust in blocks of aerogel. The samples, returned to Earth in 2006, were the first material ever brought back from a comet.
